title: unsupported MIME is blocked by the UI allowlist
environment: SAP BTP UAT generated Fiori attachment control
runtime: Codex in-app browser, authenticated as NhanT (Tester)
testCommand: Manual generated-control runtime check on controlled BUG-0025
actualResult: Selecting the controlled .exe fixture displayed the safe message 'The file format you selected is not supported.' The unsupported filename never appeared in the attachment grid; the existing controlled supported row count remained unchanged.
assertions: latest dev uses the SAP-standard generated attachment facet
retired custom MIME selection handler is absent
generated control rejects an unsupported extension with a safe message
no unsupported attachment row is created
limitations: The runtime proof covers generated-control rejection and no UI metadata row. It does not claim direct HANA/S3 inspection.
